caption: This drawing features a detailed illustration of a flute, colored in light beige and gray tones, positioned diagonally from the top left to the bottom right of the image. The flute has six evenly spaced finger holes along its length and a prominent embouchure hole near its lower section. The drawing includes fine lines indicating the metallic texture and reflective qualities of the flute. To the right of the flute, there are two rectangular boxes containing handwritten text in cursive. The upper box has fewer lines of text, while the lower box contains multiple lines. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the artist's signature, "F. HASTINGS," is visible in small, capital letters. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there are no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Fife
